title: Benevolent Bias in Multi-Turn Human–Agent Dialogue

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating off-the-shelf safety detectors and LLM judges on a synthetic dataset (BENEVDIAL) of multi-turn dialogues that manipulate agent tone and treatment toward users of different age groups to distinguish benevolent bias from overt bias.

Evaluating off-the-shelf safety detectors and LLM judges on a synthetic dataset (BENEVDIAL) of multi-turn dialogues that manipulate agent tone and treatment toward users of different genders to distinguish benevolent bias from overt bias.

Evaluating off-the-shelf safety detectors and LLM judges on a synthetic dataset (BENEVDIAL) of multi-turn dialogues that manipulate agent tone and treatment toward users of different racial groups to distinguish benevolent bias from overt bias.

Evaluating off-the-shelf safety detectors and LLM judges on a synthetic dataset (BENEVDIAL) of multi-turn dialogues that manipulate agent tone and treatment toward users with different ability statuses to distinguish benevolent bias from overt bias.
